title: Istanbul
note: Two days in Istanbul at the end of December. Twenty-three frames made it out of Lightroom; these three are printed here, and the other twenty are still on the sheet.

photos.caption: A chestnut cart outside the Blue Mosque, in the rain, with two minarets in scaffolding.
photos.alt: A street food cart with a red awning on wet paving stones; behind it, the domes of a mosque at dusk and two minarets wrapped in scaffolding.

photos.caption: Inside a ferry across the Bosphorus.
photos.alt: The lower deck of a ferry: rows of wooden benches facing a dark double door, with a red fire cabinet on each side.

photos.caption: Five cats waiting by a fisherman on the Bosphorus shore.
photos.alt: A man fishing at the railing of a waterfront promenade while five cats sit and walk around him; the far shore is behind.
